purpose: Preserve v228's historical first-pass ledger while recording five deliberately re-reviewed Chemistry definition corrections. An unchanged v228 stamp remains an assertion for every other first-pass card.
scope: Existing short flashcards only; first school mock Chemistry definitions; full AQA specification sign-off not implied.

changes.issue: Removed concentration-only wording that omitted accuracy.
First ionisation definition now explicitly gives gaseous 1+ ions.
Enthalpy of solution specifies infinite dilution rather than mere dissolving.
Standard neutralisation specifies 1 mol water, dilute aqueous solution and standard conditions.
Standard atomisation conditions clarified; gaseous atoms not gaseous ions.

validation: Five corrected model definitions and authored accepted/rejected examples independently tested against actual production evaluator by tests/task1-v336-chem-definition-precision.cjs; every first-pass snapshot not listed here must keep its original hash.
mastery: Not a claim that a student has mastered these concepts.
